synthesis

Heat the septum-capped THF precursor solution

Dissolve the reported precursor charge in THF in a septum-capped vial and heat at 66 °C. The heating duration is not supplied. Missing fields for this phase: duration. C2: Main p3 prints12mg,0.003mmol for both NMR and THF controls.448.92g/mol gives0.02673mmol. No silent tenfold correction.
